note: Registry of hazard layers for /labs prototypes. Producers append entries; consumers load whatever is listed. kind: observed | modeled | terrain-index | water | hotspot.

layers.label: Sitios y zonas de inundación (IMEPLAN MUI 2026)
layers.notes: 808 features: 310 floodable-site polygons, 188 critical-area polygons, 310 category points. Inventory of historical flooding, not a forecast.

layers.label: Cuerpos de agua (OSM: lagos, presas, vasos reguladores, canales)
layers.notes: 408 OSM water areas (natural=water, landuse=reservoir|basin, waterway=riverbank|dock; pools/fountains excluded), clipped to the AOI, simplified 2 m, < 300 m² dropped. Mapped permanent water, not flooding. Properties: id, name, water, tipo, label, intermittent, area_m2.

router.note: Router: kind water default x50 on the covered fraction of an edge; bridges exempt. Not blocked by blockCritical.

layers.label: Pasos a desnivel y vías deprimidas (OSM)
layers.notes: 776 LineStrings in 404 sites (property site). confidence 'alta': road mapped below grade in OSM (tunnel=*, layer<0, cutting=*). confidence 'media': at-grade road crossed by a road/rail bridge (inferred lower road, ±45 m around the crossing). Classic flooding points, derived from road tags — not an observed flood record. Properties: id, site, label, reason, confidence, name, highway, over, osm_way_id, length_m, marker [lon,lat].

router.note: Router: confidence 'alta' x10 (x50 in safe mode with blockCritical, the default), 'media' x4, on the covered fraction of the same OSM way only (bridges above are not penalised). Set router.critical:false to opt out of blockCritical.

layers.label: Servicios por inundación atendidos en Zapopan 2017–2025 (Protección Civil y Bomberos)
layers.notes: 2,230 dated emergency-call points (Zapopan only): vía pública 1103, casa habitación 762, paso a desnivel 84, comercio 49, edificio público 25, other/sin especificar 207. Properties fecha, hora, anio, tipo, colonia, calle, fallecidos, lesionados. Source: Gobierno de Zapopan ArcGIS Online (3 layers merged, personal fields removed). Observed incidents, not extents or depths.

layers.label: Pasos a desnivel con riesgo de inundación (Zapopan)
layers.notes: 29 municipal points with riesgo alto/medio/bajo and causa (e.g. Basura). Complements the router's OSM-derived underpasses layer (hazard/underpasses.geojson), which covers the whole metro.

layers.label: Puntos de inundación recurrentes — reportes de prensa 2023–2026
layers.notes: 78 points compiled from news (often reproducing municipal lists). Approximate geocodes (street crossings / named places). Label as 'reportes de prensa'; not official observations. Each has sources and nearest IMEPLAN site.

layers.label: Inundaciones reportadas en Guadalajara 2010–2022 (Atlas de Riesgos)
layers.notes: 3,870 dated points (street + cross street) with nivel_cm (reported water level; unit inferred cm), sector (vía pública 2,311, casa habitación ~980, ...). Municipality of Guadalajara only; source Gobierno de Guadalajara Atlas de Riesgos WMS. Observed reports.

router.reason: 3,870 historical incident points (2010-2022) published after the router was tested; left out of hazardIds:"all" until the router agent evaluates it (remove this flag to opt in). Pass the id explicitly to use it.

layers.label: Áreas de inundación registradas en Guadalajara (Bomberos/PC, niveles)
layers.notes: 198 polygons with nivel 10-30 cm, 30-100 cm or histórica; fuente Bomberos, UEPCyB, SVT, UdG, Geografía municipal. Guadalajara only.

layers.label: Riesgo de inundación a partir de MDT (Atlas de Riesgos de Guadalajara, modelo municipal)
layers.notes: 112 polygons, third-party municipal terrain-based analysis (method undocumented). Modeled by the municipality, not by cauce.; label accordingly.

layers.label: Pasos a desnivel del Atlas de Riesgos de Guadalajara
layers.notes: 11 named underpasses listed by the municipal risk atlas (e.g. Lázaro Cárdenas y Mariano Otero, Niños Héroes e Inglaterra). Subset of the router's OSM underpasses, but with official naming.

layers.label: Susceptibilidad del terreno a inundación (0–1, modelo validado con IMEPLAN)
layers.notes: Percentile score (0-1) among 25 m urban blocks of a logistic model on HAND, depression depth, TWI and TPI; spatial-CV AUC 0.807. Urban fabric only. Static terrain index, not depth or probability. Palette in stats.json tiles.susceptibilidad.palette (code = 1 + 254*score).

router.note: Display tiles; for routing use sim-relieve-susceptibilidad-alta.

layers.label: Zonas de susceptibilidad alta del terreno (polígonos)
layers.notes: 978 'alta' (score >= 0.80) and 675 'muy alta' (>= 0.93) polygons from a 3x3-smoothed 25 m score, >= 5,000 m2, simplified 6 m. Nested: 'muy alta' polygons lie inside 'alta' ones. Properties: id, class, label, score, score_min, area_m2, scenario.

router.note: Opt-in: large areas; static susceptibility, not water. Suggested multipliers alta x1.4, muy alta x2 (per-feature router_cost).

layers.label: Depresiones del terreno donde se estanca el agua (relleno ≥ 10 cm, polígonos)
layers.notes: 6298 largest depression patches by volume (6,000 in the urban fabric + 300 outside), building-aware DEM, open ground only, fill depth >= 10 cm. Properties: id, class (somera <0.3 m / media / profunda >= 1 m), label, depth_m_min, depth_m_max, volume_m3, area_m2, contrib_area_m2, fill_rain_mm (rain depth that would fill it if all catchment rain arrived), urban, rank, scenario. Static fill, no drainage: an upper bound on ponding, not a forecast. Some deep ones are quarries/excavations.

router.note: Opt-in (static terrain capacity, not observed water; 4,582 of the 6,298 are >= 1 m deep). Per-feature router_cost by class: somera 1.3, media 1.8, profunda 2.5.

layers.label: Profundidad de depresiones (5 m, display)
layers.notes: Fill depth 0.10-5 m (log palette) on open ground, building-aware DEM. Display only.

layers.label: Altura sobre el cauce (HAND, 5 m)
layers.notes: Height above nearest drainage (streams >= 1 km2 upslope, building-aware D8 routing, bare-earth DTM heights). 0-30 m log palette, transparent above 30 m. Best single predictor of IMEPLAN sites (AUC 0.792). Display only.

layers.label: Flujo acumulado (área drenada D8, 5 m)
layers.notes: Upslope area 0.0025-2,500 km2 (log palette), building-aware D8 (buildings as walls, so flow runs down streets). Zoom-dependent minimum area. Display only.

layers.label: Planitud del terreno (pendiente en ~175 m)
layers.notes: Slope of the 25 m block-mean DTM over a ~175 m window; amber = flat (0.2 %), transparent above 10 %. Display only.

layers.label: Peligro de inundación Tr 100 años (modelo del Gobierno de Zapopan)
layers.attribution: Gobierno de Zapopan (Geomática / Protección Civil y Bomberos)
layers.notes: Third-party municipal model (100-year return period), served as cached ArcGIS tiles (XYZ order z/y/x, PNG/JPG mixed, CORS ok for guadalajara.vsfelix.com). Method, legend and date not documented in the service; webmap "Mancha de Inundación Área Urbana Zapopan". Zapopan municipality only. Modeled by Zapopan, not by cauce.

layers.label: Brecha de infraestructura: dónde el drenaje basta y dónde no (modelo sim-drenaje)
layers.notes: Urban 20 m cells. a (orange) floods even with ≥40 mm/h of drainage → storage/regrading/relocation (71.7 km²); b (aqua) floods at ≤10 mm/h but much less with ≥40 → drainage upgrade pays off (55.36 km²); c (faint gray) rarely floods. Rule: a (persistente): f_low >= 0.25 and f_high >= 0.5*f_low; b (responde al drenaje): f_low >= 0.25 and f_high < 0.5*f_low; c (rara vez): f_low < 0.25.
